af_codes.meaning: provisioning (the create POST) or SMS verification (the send-test-message POST) was requested without the operator's explicit --execute (the Trevor gate) — a refusal, never a silent no-op and never a silent write
listing numbers for the location failed (scope / validation / edge block / transport) — STOP (exit 2) or HELD (exit 3) per class, never a silent skip, never a provision-into-the-unknown
the POST /phones/numbers was rejected (validation / scope / edge block / transport), or the response carried no number id — STOP, HELD or MISMATCH per class, never recorded as provisioned
the verify read-back or the send-test-message POST failed (scope / validation / edge / transport) — STOP or HELD per class, never a false pass
the verification read-back never confirmed sending-capable within the bounded window — HELD (exit 3), never a false pass
the post-create read-back returned no number object for the created id — nothing is ever reported provisioned without read-back
an attack fixture tripped the OFFLINE self-test (enforced violation)

exit_codes.0: verified success — all checks PASS (also plan / dry-run / self-test)
exit_codes.1: unexpected error (top-level guard; never a secret leak)
exit_codes.2: STOP refusal — label NOT SET / non-pit- value / usage / an ACTION (provision, send, verify) without --execute / a module missing from u23_modules/ (AF-AE-U23-ASSEMBLY-INCOMPLETE) / a genuine scope denial
exit_codes.3: HELD — Convert and Flow API unreachable / verification not confirmed / upstream edge block (CF error 1010); retryable, never mislabeled as a scope problem
exit_codes.4: self-test FAILED — an assertion in the OFFLINE self-test tripped (AF-AE-PROVPHONE-* / AF-AE-SMSVER-* / AF-AE-TEMPLATE-ATTACK family). A tamper NEVER masquerades as exit 1
exit_codes.5: data or read-back mismatch — a create returned no number id / a verify read-back returned no number / a send returned 200 with no SID / the golden or attack fixture drifted; the fail-closed default

fail_closed.note: the no-phone listing is refused UP FRONT (AF-AE-PROVPHONE-NO-PHONE) and the non-200 send attack FAILS every SMS-verification gate with the golden 200-send control PASSING — the pass/fail splits discriminate the ONE-variable boundaries, never a broken instrument; the PROVISIONING ACTION requires --execute (Trevor-gated), never a silent write.
